arms.A: Reset after every episode, original candidate order.
arms.B: Full ordinary transcript; recompute original retention by scanning all past checked rows.
arms.C: Executable ledger of all observed candidate programs and evidence; index source support.
arms.D: Existing UDM Machine with source-bound typed capabilities; use only live independently checked source supports. Fresh native verification is always required for future candidate consequences.

budgets_are_matched: Every arm gets 32 search candidates/task and 2400 total native calls. Extra UDM admission, cold recovery and ablation calls are charged to D; no extra search. Rotate arm positions ABCD/BCDA/CDAB/DABC by encountered task group. Common controls charged separately.
causal: On any D gain over A, remove all relevant live signature support, rerun exact future, fresh-reverify original source support and restore; test irrelevant support removal and changed source hash. If no gain, causal capability-growth claim remains unestablished.
checkpoint_isolation: Evaluation shards disjoint 3 at each checkpoint. Evaluation outputs never enter memory, training or protocol revisions. Scores across shards are not same-task paired learning slopes.
cost_boundary: Start wall clock before domain controls/graph initialization. Record preprocessing (downloads/install) separately from measured campaign; unmeasured historical engineering remains UNKNOWN, so do not claim all-in G4 superiority from this pilot.
initial_capabilities: Supplied V104 75 selector/builder pairs, no retained signatures; original UDM Machine/Metatron/FLASH for D. Prior QuixBugs-derived signatures not loaded.
model: No LLM calls: common fixed original V104 enumerative constructor in every arm. This pilot does not test a general-purpose LLM agent.
qualification_profile: NEW research-only Refactory/V104 profile over original Machine; original UDM qualification does not qualify this profile. Fresh external native scores, exact source/test/runtime/runner binding, complete nonempty test maps, source-distinct support and cold read required. No external effect authority.
retention: Unchanged V104 support >=2 distinct source programs; shortest repr then strongest support then frozen hash top2. No claim of independent repository support.
selection: Four questions 1..4, first six lexically named wrong Python files per family; first three training, next three evaluation; interleave by file rank then question. Metadata-only selection. No replacement on parse/admission/scientific failure. Encounter chronology; original submission dates unavailable.
stopping: Stop on false warrant, original verifier mismatch, leakage, budget cap, source or protocol drift. No scale-up without meaningful heldout gain and causal controls.
success: Any acquired-signature-dependent future full native PASS beyond A under fixed candidate count; compare B/C/D on exact same tasks. D vs competent C ties valid; no economics claim without costs.

supersedes_before_task_access.reason: Fresh pre-run review: match arm budgets, cache competent ledger, counterbalance positions, bind original oracle, require actual cold process and causal controls; task identities and generator/test boundaries unchanged.

unknowns: Public-corpus pretraining exposure not excluded (no LLM used here).
This is unfamiliar source-program repair under four repeated exercise requirements, not new-domain semantics.
G2 novel observation language, prospective O1→O2→O3, G5 refinement and G6 authority not tested.
verification: Exact original Refactory Tester.tv_code, nonempty complete original test IDs; no reference implementation exposed to generator; isolated verifier process. False program and missing-test controls. Full native PASS requires all original cases, fresh second-process confirmation. Partial score improvements can support search signatures but are not full correctness.
